jobs.title: New Zealand Securities Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be at the center of equity trading operations in Australia & New Zealand?

Do you thrive working closely with the trading desk, taking ownership of risk outcomes, and improving how things are done?

We’re looking for a proactive Middle Office professional seeking genuine front office exposure, ownership of key controls, and the opportunity to drive meaningful process improvement and automation—primarily for New Zealand, with additional responsibility supporting Australia.

In this role, you’ll sit at the heart of the Australia & New Zealand Equities business, partnering closely with Trading, Business Management, clients, and global support teams. You’ll own critical front to back controls, ensure trade integrity, and play a key role in managing operational and risk outcomes on T0 and beyond.
You’ll be trusted to act decisively, think critically, and continuously improve how we support the business.

• Own and operate a suite of front to back controls, identifying and capturing risk events as part of the first line of defense
• Ensure T0 trade data integrity, with a strong focus on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness
• Produce and facilitate sign off for T0 risk reporting and T+1 reconciliations
• Act as a key point of contact for Australia & New Zealand Equities Trading desks and Business Managers, providing time critical support
• Liaise with clients and external brokers to resolve trade booking and economic discrepancies
• Partner with the business and local support functions on new initiatives, change, and process improvement to enhance efficiency and control
• Drive automation and continuous improvement, leveraging data and tooling to reduce risk and manual effort

jobs.title: Client Account Manager
jobs.description:
Do you want to proactively go the extra mile with us to help clients? Are you focused on the details, even when under pressure?

We’re looking for a Client Account Manager (CAM) to:

• support client advisors in delivering exceptional client service and experience
• be point-of-entry contact for clients with account queries or orders, stock orders, payments, etc.
• assist with account opening, onboarding, due diligence and monitoring activities
• support with documentation for client meetings, business trips, investment proposals and the like
• collaborate with colleagues to ensure that all client accounts comply with legal, compliance and regulatory requirements
• Assist with daily operation, including various administrative and functional tasks.
• Communicate with our colleagues in Luxembourg (Booking Centre)
• Assist and participate at our events

jobs.title: Market Administrative Officer
jobs.description:
Are you a leader people look up to? Do you know brokerage operations principles and regulatory rules by heart?

We’re looking for a market administrative officer to:

• Lead the Operations and Administrative Management Team
• Manage end to end process of recruitment and development of the Operations and Administrative
Management Team and other direct reports where required
• Manage branch administration, including branch facilities and overall cost management to enhance
profitability
• Oversee and approve new client accounts, errors, client correspondence and communications
• Advise and manage HR-related issues in the market
• Ensure that all market/branch employees are educated and receive coaching on administrative policies,
procedures and risk management
• Implement service excellence standards that include coaching and educating Management and support staff
on Client Experience best practices and suitability
• Oversee employee related activity and manage the transition of recruits' accounts

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Spezialist/in Hypotheken und Grundbuchwesen 80 – 100%
jobs.description:
Hast du Erfahrungen in der Hypothekarverarbeitung und dem Schweizerischen Grundbuchwesen?
Ist effizientes, exaktes und verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten genau deine Stärke?
Hast du Freude an administrativen Tätigkeiten mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten?

Dann bewirb dich, denn wir wollen wachsen und suchen Verstärkung!

Deine Aufgaben:
• Selbständige Abwicklung der bewilligten Kreditgesuche
• Erstellen von allen notwendigen Kredit- und Sicherungsdokumenten
• Abbilden und Bewirtschaften von Hypotheken und Sicherheiten (z.B. Grundpfänder, Policen, Bürgschaften)
• Erstellen von Zahlungsversprechen sowie fristgerechter Ausführung von Zahlungen
• Sicherstellung aller Bedingungen für die Freigabe der Hypotheken und Zahlungen
• Begleitung und korrekte Terminierung der Geschäftsfälle in Eigenverantwortung
• Korrespondenz mit Grundbuchämtern, Notaren, Banken und Versicherungsgesellschaften
• Pflichtbewusster Umgang mit potenziellen Risiken

jobs.title: Equity Derivatives Quant Developer
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Quantitative Developer? Do you enjoy innovative thinking? We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Developer to join our Equity Derivatives Quantitative Development (EMEA) team within UBS Global Markets toŁ

- latency analysis and optimization
- enhancing the proprietary eTrading framework that is used across the department

Support the end-to-end card lifecycle, including production, personalization, distribution, maintenance, and issue resolution, while helping ensure service levels are met and operational risks are identified and addressed promptly.

Perform reconciliations across multiple general ledgers and card processing accounts, researching outages, transaction breaks, and exceptions to support timely resolution and reduce financial and operational risk.

jobs.title: Fund Accountant
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong attention to detail that enables robust accounting oversight and sound risk governance? Do you thrive in cross‑functional and multi‑regional environments? Are you a diligent, process‑driven professional with deep fund accounting expertise?
We are looking for a Fund Accountant who will play a key role in overseeing Taiwan fund accounting activities and contributing to regional initiatives.
The successful candidate will:
• Represent Taiwan Fund Accounting at both local and regional levels, and contribute to cross functional and cross regional projects
• Support and oversee fund accounting–related regulatory reporting
• Apply strong technical expertise in NAV calculation and valuation
• Demonstrate a strong risk and control mindset in overseeing fund administration vendors
• Coordinate fund financial statement audits with external auditors
• Manage trade processing, settlement, and related controls, working closely with front and middle offices to resolve trade discrepancies and mitigate operational risks
• Act as a key point of contact for external clients and internal stakeholders, responding to fund accounting–related inquiries in a timely and professional manner
• Ensure all control processes and procedures (e.g., reconciliations, payments) comply with UBS standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements
• Support and manage fund life‑cycle events, including (but not limited to) fund launches, mergers, liquidations, and fund maturities
• Design and deliver customized reports to meet client and business requirements
• Provide support for APAC cross‑regional initiatives and tasks as required

jobs.title: Competitive Underwriter
jobs.description:
The Competitive Underwriter is responsible for pricing, structuring, and executing municipal bond transactions in competitive sale processes. This role partners closely with sales and trading to evaluate deals, develop bid strategies, and manage risk to maximize win rates and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Evaluation & Pricing
• Analyze municipal bond announcements for competitive bids
• Build pricing scales, yield curves, and relative value assessments
• Evaluate credit fundamentals, structure, call features, and investor demand
• Determine optimal bid levels balancing risk, return, and win probability

Market Strategy & Execution
• Develop and execute bidding strategies for competitive transactions
• Monitor market conditions (rates, flows, supply/demand, comparable trades)
• Coordinate with trading desk on secondary levels and positioning
• Submit bids and manage award process in real time

Risk Management
• Assess market and inventory risk associated with awarded deals
• Work with trading to hedge or distribute risk efficiently
• Ensure adherence to firm risk limits and capital usage guidelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with:
• Sales: gauge investor demand and pricing appetite
• Trading: align on secondary levels and liquidity
• Provide feedback to improve competitiveness

Post-Award Execution
• Support allocation, distribution, and secondary market trading strategies
• Monitor performance of won deals and refine future pricing approaches
• Maintain records of bids, outcomes, and competitor behavior

jobs.title: Credit Risk Officer - Hedge Funds

titleByLocale.it: Credit Risk Officer - Fondi di copertura

jobs.description:
Your role
Are you naturally curious and ambitious? Do you have strong analytical skills? We’re looking for someone who can:
•assess counterparty credit risk using a solid understanding of hedge fund and family office risk management, trading strategies, infrastructure, and other quantitative and qualitative credit factors, including onsite due diligence
•use delegated authority, within defined risk limits, to approve new positions or recommend decisions to senior credit committees, working closely with the business to ensure transactions align with UBS’s risk appetite
• •evaluate transactional risk across OTC derivatives, securities financing, exchange-traded derivatives, banking products, and structured transactions
• •prepare, review, and approve annual counterparty reviews and transactional credit proposals, clearly setting out credit assessments, risk appetite, exposure drivers, and business outlook
• •lead negotiation of trading documentation, including ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage, and Repo Agreements
• •manage regulatory requests, audit items, and operational risk issues in a timely and disciplined way
• •deliver ad hoc credit analysis and contribute to portfolio reviews to identify emerging risks and concentrations

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Market risk quant in the Market risk model validation team in India to perform:
• Independent validation of market risk models in line with the UBS model governance policy and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities include
• Assess the model's conceptual soundness and methodology
• Check the appropriateness/quality of input data used for model development, review appropriateness of model parameters, accuracy of the model calibration etc.
• Review model outcome, impacts, or develop alternate benchmark approaches to challenge model outputs (as appropriate)
• Assess model risk, providing effective challenge to model assumptions and evaluate model limitations
• Write comprehensive validation reports, documenting the assessments to required standards
• Collaborate effectively with stakeholders globally to understand / challenge potential model risks; communicate validation findings to relevant stakeholders
• Support ongoing review of model performance and model change reviews to ensure models remain fit for purpose

jobs.title: Investment Banking Associate - Leveraged Finance Origination

titleByLocale.en: Investment Banking Associate - Leveraged Finance Origination
titleByLocale.it: Investment Banking Associate - Leveraged Finanza Origination
titleByLocale.de: Investment Banking Associate - Leveraged Finanzen Origination
titleByLocale.fr: Investment Banking Associate - Leveraged Finance Origination

jobs.description:
UBS is seeking a highly motivated Associate to join its Leveraged Finance Origination team in London. The team is responsible for the origination, structuring, underwriting and syndication of leveraged loan and high yield bond financings for financial sponsor and corporate clients across EMEA.
As an Associate, you will play a central role in executing transactions, supporting senior bankers in client coverage, and managing deal processes from origination through distribution. The role offers significant exposure to private equity sponsors, corporate management teams, investors, and internal risk partners, and requires strong analytical capability, commercial judgment, and execution discipline.

Key Responsibilities include:
Transaction Execution
• Support the structuring and execution of leveraged loans, high yield bonds and related financing solutions for sponsor backed and corporate transactions, including LBOs, acquisitions, refinancings and recapitalisations
• Coordinate deal execution across internal stakeholders including coverage, credit risk, syndicate, legal and operations teams

Financial Analysis & Modelling
• Build and review detailed financial models, including LBO, cash flow, leverage and covenant analyses
• Assess credit profiles, capital structures and debt capacity across a range of industries and business models

Credit & Risk Management
• Prepare credit approval materials and present recommendations to internal credit committees
• Act as a first line of defense in assessing underwriting, market and distribution risk

Marketing & Syndication
• Produce high quality pitch books, information memoranda and investor presentations
• Assist in the syndication of underwritten transactions, including managing investor feedback, order books and roadshow logistics

Client & Sponsor Interaction
• Support senior bankers in client and sponsor dialogue, including transaction structuring discussions and market updates
• Contribute to idea generation and development of financing solutions tailored to client objectives

jobs.description:
Are you an expert in researching credit investment opportunities? Do you have any experience in leveraged loans and high yield bonds? Are you good at making investment recommendations based on your assessments?

We are looking for Research Analyst Leveraged Loans & High Yield Bonds to

• conduct fundamental credit analysis on leveraged loans and high yield bonds, including detailed review of financial statements, operating performance, and credit risk drivers
• build and maintain financial models to project cash flows, assess leverage, covenant compliance, and downside scenarios
• prepare high quality investment memoranda and support Portfolio Managers during Investment Committee discussions with clear analysis and recommendations
• evaluate new primary market opportunities by reviewing offering materials, attending management or bank calls, and assessing deal terms and documentation
• monitor secondary market positions, tracking performance, pricing, and credit developments, and flagging risks or opportunities to the investment team
• support ongoing portfolio monitoring by updating models, preparing credit reviews, and contributing to risk, valuation, and investor reporting

jobs.title: Operational Risk Control Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable working in a second line of defense role, able to provide independent analysis and an “effective challenge” to the 1LoD, while remaining pragmatic?
Are you able to react quickly and with sound judgment, balancing business objectives with legal, regulatory, and ethical requirements?
In this role, you will support second line of defense (2LoD) Operational Risk and Compliance activities for Global Wealth Management (GWM) as well as for support functions (HR, Finance, Operations, etc.).
You will work under the supervision of the Head of Operational Risk Control (ORC) and senior team members, contributing to risk monitoring, risk assessments, reporting, and control activities, while developing your expertise in non-financial risks.
This role is particularly suited to a junior profile looking to build a strong foundation in operational risk, compliance, and regulatory matters within a structured environment.

Your responsibilities

• Support Operational Risk Control and Compliance (second line of defense) activities for GWM and support functions at the local level.
• Contribute to the implementation and monitoring of the non-financial risk framework, in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
• Participate in key risk management processes (RCSA, incidents, Front-to-Back controls, risk appetite) and ensure escalation of identified risks.
• Prepare and consolidate reporting, risk analyses, and governance materials, as well as track remediation action plans.
• Support second-level controls, thematic reviews (AML/KYC, fraud, suitability, etc.), and interactions with audit and regulatory authorities.
